changelog.summary: Optional per-signature authority: requireAssertionPerSignature makes every signature need a fresh passkey assertion, verified inside the TEE against a single-use 60s challenge, instead of an unlocked session signing freely until expiry. The session still stays warm — this does NOT shorten sessionDurationMinutes. Available on both DecaneConnectConfig and SocialConfig. Default false, so existing behaviour is unchanged. Requires TEE signer v0.2.3+.

Custom auth: sign in with a JWT from your own issuer (Auth0, Clerk, Firebase, Cognito, or your own backend). Adds DecaneConnect.connectWithToken(token, opts?), SocialConfig.customAuth, and useSocialAuth().signInWithToken / .signInWithCustomAuth. Backward compatible — no existing API changed.
Baseline for this manifest. Wallet connect (EVM, Solana, Tron, Bitcoin) plus non-custodial social sign-in via Google and email, TEE-backed signing, 2-of-3 Shamir recovery.
